_comment: Maintained by a human from the exchange's published trading-holiday circular each year. Format: { "YYYY": [ {"date": "YYYY-MM-DD", "description": "..."} ] }. Never invent dates: leave a year empty until the owner provides it. If a year has no rows the app uses weekends only, shows a warning on /admin/status and a 'holiday list missing' notice in the stock header chip. Owners can also load a year with the holidays import (docs/01 section 7.8). No automatic holiday detection.
